question: What was the outcome of the 2026 São Toméan presidential election in July?
answer:
The outcome of the 2026 São Toméan presidential election was that incumbent president Carlos Vila Nova won re-election in the first round with 55.88% of the vote, while his main opposition candidate, Nito Abreu, received 41.46%. 

FINAL: Carlos Vila Nova won re-election.
